none: PAS NLM-7D3698: Roman Coin: radiate of Claudius II from Roxby cum Risby
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C CLAUDIVS AVG ; R/ [--]AVG

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate of Claudius II (268-270), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust draped right. Obverse inscription: IMP C CLAUDIVS AVG. Reverse description: Figure, possibly Providentia, holding cornucopiae in left hand and pointing down with right. Reverse inscription: [--]AVG. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 20.8mm, Weight: 2.73gms, die axis: 6
